adversarial_audit.objection: The maximum correlation 1/(n-1) describes a typical residual coefficient.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Rank weighting is fourth-power in carrier dimensions; low-dimensional maximum-correlation carriers have factorially small q-mass.

adversarial_audit.objection: Unconditioned annealed row expectations transfer to the globally distinct sector because P_cf tends to one.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Generic additive transfer is too weak at the tiny row scale. The module instead transfers a high-probability simultaneous relative-concentration event.

adversarial_audit.objection: Small channel-rank mass proves negligible quantum state mass.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The PGM can reweight coefficient sectors; an explicit trace/normalization theorem is still missing.

claim_gate.reason: Typical coefficient rank is concentrated on factorially weak overlaps, but the PGM weighting and endpoint-short transfer are open.

falsifiers_triggered: Worst-case residual correlation is not a representative mass statistic.
Total-variation conditioning cannot transfer a factorially small annealed row expectation relatively.
Coefficient-rank typicality is not yet accepted-state or PGM-effect typicality.

proof_obligations.resolution: Seven concentrated block multiplicities give the exact fourth-power carrier law on typical triples.
The proof conditions a simultaneous multiplicity event, then divides its failure probability by P_cf; it does not transfer the tiny row mass additively.
The fourth-power law plus the maximal-dimension lower bound on Z4 gives the factorial tail.
Need a trace identity linking carrier row multiplicities through the global distinct kernel, endpoint shorts, and PGM normalization.

summary: Replaced worst-case reciprocal correlation by the typical rank-weighted d^4 carrier law and proved its high-correlation tail factorially small on density-one collision-free triples.

theorem_contract.correlation_tail: Outside (n!)^-1/2 exp(O(sqrt n)) q-mass, both carrier dimensions exceed (n!)^(3/8), so gamma<=(n!)^-3/4.
theorem_contract.fixed_factor_variance: A fixed target tensor factor inserts r_nu(K)^2<=1 into the same exact class-size second moment, so the universal variance bound survives.
theorem_contract.fourth_power_law: Each star row then has rank within (1+/-eta)^7 of d_beta^4 d_p^4/(n!)^7, inducing q(alpha)=d_alpha^4/Z4.
theorem_contract.portfolio_conversion: If the conditioned joint source/triple bad probability is delta, then with probability at least 1-sqrt(delta), a source portfolio has at most sqrt(delta) bad triples.
theorem_contract.scope: The measure is coefficient-channel rank. Its relation to accepted PGM state mass and shorted endpoint spectra is unproved.
theorem_contract.typical_pattern_blocks: Three random orientations distribute source pairs among four complement-pattern classes; an optimized multinomial tail bounds small blocks.
theorem_contract.uniform_carrier_multiplicities: On a high-probability event, every output carrier in every active pattern block has normalized multiplicity within 1+/-eta of d_alpha/n!.
